# ssh tools

SSH key management - add, list, and remove SSH keys for git authentication

2 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `list_ssh_keys`

List all SSH keys (CIDX-managed and unmanaged).

- Permission: `repository:admin`
- Source: [ssh/list_ssh_keys.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/ssh/list_ssh_keys.md)

No parameters.

## `manage_ssh_key`

Create, delete, show public key, or assign host for a CIDX-managed SSH key.

- Permission: `repository:admin`
- Source: [ssh/manage_ssh_key.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/ssh/manage_ssh_key.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `action` | string (one of: `create`, `delete`, `show_public`, `assign_host`) | yes | Operation to perform. create: generate new key pair. delete: remove managed key. show_public: get public key content. assign_host: add SSH config Host entry. |
| `name` | string | yes | Key name (identifier). |
| `key_type` | string (one of: `ed25519`, `rsa`) | no | Key type to generate (create only). ed25519: modern and fast (default). rsa: 4096-bit, wider compatibility. |
| `email` | string | no | Email address for key comment (create only). |
| `description` | string | no | Human-readable description of key purpose (create only). |
| `hostname` | string | no | Hostname or Host alias for SSH config (assign_host only). |
| `force` | boolean | no | Force overwrite if hostname already exists in SSH config (assign_host only). |
